subject: Residency switchover playbook and evidence for EU / APAC private deployment
messages:
From: Sara Lindholm <sara.lindholm@acme-fin.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme-fin.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Private deployment residency — architecture and evidence request

Hi Mina,

Thanks for taking the call yesterday. As we move toward the security review for our EU + APAC private deployment evaluation, the audit team has asked for: a concise architecture diagram showing data paths for EU and APAC customers, proof that KMS keys/crypto material never egress EU/APAC boundaries during normal operation, and a draft switchover playbook describing how traffic is moved and how custody is proven after failover.

We'd like a single deliverable we can attach to our internal SOC review packet by next Friday (2027-07-30). Key questions up front:
- Does your KMS support region-bound keys for private deployments (customer-managed)?
- During an EU->APAC warm-standby switchover, what evidence will you provide that no EU-resident PII left region?
- Is there a formal tabletop/drill runbook we can exercise with our infra team?

Can you also indicate if Redwood will require any peering (BGP) changes or cross-border NAT for the initial proof-of-concept? Procurement copied for timeline.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Lindholm
Security Program Manager, Acme Financial Services

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lindholm <sara.lindholm@acme-fin.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 13:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Private deployment residency — architecture and evidence request

Sara,

Appreciate the clear asks. I've attached a concise architecture diagram (redwood-private-eu-apac-arch.pdf) and outlined the answers below — long-form runbook will follow from Jonas and ops.

Short answers:
- KMS: Yes — we support customer-managed keys (CMKs) in customer VPCs. For Private deployments we can integrate with your cloud KMS (customer-supplied) or manage keys in a region-specific HSM. We will provide signed attestations and KMS audit logs with region tags.
- Evidence during switchover: We provide request-level ingress/egress traces, per-request residency labels, and a custody transfer report summarizing the last EU-processed offsets for persisted objects. We can produce a cryptographic evidence bundle (hash manifests) that your auditors can verify.
- Tabletop/drill: Ops can provide a 4-step tabletop with clear preconditions, triggers, and rollback criteria. We propose a tabletop drill on 2027-07-27 (preferred) or the week after.

Peering: For the proof-of-concept we recommend a temporary private peering connection to avoid internet egress and to capture flows for evidence. That said, the production option supports both VPC peering and private interconnects; cross-border NAT is avoidable if you provision private connectivity.

Next steps: Jonas will circulate the runbook and Rishi will attach KMS logs and an example audit bundle. Marissa will coordinate the drill scheduling and procurement items.

Best,
Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Platform Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-private-eu-apac-arch.pdf (diagram)

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lindholm <sara.lindholm@acme-fin.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 08:45:00 +0000
Subject: Draft runbook: EU/APAC switchover (version 0.1)

Hi all,

Attached is the first draft of a runbook that operationalizes the switchover and evidence collection for a private deployment (eu/apac). This is intentionally concise so your auditors can follow the sequence. Highlights:

1) Preconditions
 - Confirm KMS key residency and that KMS audit streaming to your log collector is configured.
 - Ensure private peering established and route filters applied.
 - Baseline snapshot of KV caches and offsets captured (hash and timestamp).

2) Switchover trigger and execution
 - Trigger: customer-controlled (manual) OR automated metric threshold (latency/region outage).
 - Actions (atomic): a) freeze new writes to EU write-path b) sync last-kv snapshot -> artifact signed c) shift routing policy for new requests to APAC cluster d) start ingest verification for a sample cohort.

3) Evidence artifacts produced
 - Signed KV manifest (hash list + timestamp)
 - Ingress/egress trace file for the switchover window
 - KMS audit log slice with region tag and key id
 - Routing decision audit (policy change record)

4) Rollback criteria and verification checks
 - If post-switchover sample verification fails >2% or latency outside SLA, automatically revert routing and rehydrate caches from signed artifact.

I'm attaching the doc: eu-apac-switchover-runbook-v1.docx. Please review and tell me where you need more detail; we can expand verification checks or include packet-level evidence if your auditors require it.

Jonas
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Sara Lindholm <sara.lindholm@acme-fin.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Paul Kim <paul.kim@acme-fin.com>, procurement@acme-fin.com
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 10:22:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Draft runbook: EU/APAC switchover (version 0.1)

Jonas — this is helpful, thanks. A few clarifying items from the audit and procurement side:

- KMS evidence: can you provide a sample KMS audit slice with key ids redacted but region tags preserved? We will include it in our packet (scrubbed).
- Network: procurement wants confirmation of whether any global BGP advertisements are required for the warm-standby option, or if all traffic can be bound to regional prefixes and switched at the application-layer only.
- Timeline: procurement is pushing for final artifact delivery by EOD 2027-07-30; are you able to commit to a finalized runbook, evidence artifact examples, and a drill schedule before then?

Also looping Paul (infra compliance) for acceptance criteria.

—Sara

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lindholm <sara.lindholm@acme-fin.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, procurement@acme-fin.com
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 15:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Draft runbook: EU/APAC switchover (version 0.1)

Sara / Paul / Procurement team,

Short answers to the clarifications:
- KMS slice: Rishi will provide a redacted example KMS audit bundle (kms-residency-evidence.zip) showing region tags and request ids — that will be suitable for your SOC packet.
- BGP: For the warm-standby pattern we proposed, no global BGP advertisement is strictly required. Route switching can be implemented at the application/proxy layer using our routing policy (preferred for fast rollback). If you require carrier-level failover we can support BGP changes but that becomes a joint network operation and takes longer to coordinate.
- Timeline: We can deliver finalized runbook, KMS example bundle, and proposed drill window by 2027-07-27 EOD. Procurement: please confirm the window to schedule the tabletop (we can do 2027-07-27 morning UTC).

HubSpot deal: ACME-RED-2027-09 — Marissa, please follow up with procurement for the final paperwork.

Thanks,
Mina

From: Paul Kim <paul.kim@acme-fin.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Sara Lindholm <sara.lindholm@acme-fin.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-fin.com, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 16:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Draft runbook: EU/APAC switchover (version 0.1) — acceptance and drill confirmation

Mina and team —

We reviewed the draft runbook and the sample artifacts. We appreciate the redaction-friendly KMS slice and the signed KV manifest example; that gives the auditors enough to move forward. We confirm the tabletop drill on 2027-07-27 09:00 UTC (ACME infra will join). For longer-term production we'll follow up on the carrier/BGP option but for now app-layer routing is acceptable.

Action items for Redwood before the drill:
- Provide final runbook PDF and a short video walkthrough (10–12 minutes) covering evidence collection steps.
- Provide a bundled evidence sample (kms-residency-evidence.zip) and a hash manifest for verification.

Procurement, you have the timeline to prepare the PO.

Thanks — looking forward to the drill.

Paul
Infra Compliance, Acme Financial Services
